tips.text: Check your dojo has Cerata researched in the Bio Lab first; the research chain behind it takes three days a step.
Buy four Mutagen Mass blueprints from the Bio Lab; each is single-use and none come with the Cerata blueprint.
Keep your dojo at ghost-clan size if you research it yourself; research costs scale with clan tier.
Nobody complains about getting Cerata; it is cheap clantech that people also call a real weapon.
